name: Tabs
purpose: Switch between related views in the same context.
intent: An accessible tab bar (line or contained) that manages selection and wires optional panels.

parts.tab: code-parts / <tab> (node 2140:67951): the individual tab, with type (line/contained) x state (default/hover/focus) x isSelected

figmaSource.notes: Figma `tabs` is the tab BAR only (no panels): type (line/contained) + showBorder. Panels are provided in code via optional TabPanel children. State model is controlled + uncontrolled.

useCases: switch between peer views of a subject (Overview / Activity / Documents)
organize a section into a few related panels
antiPatterns: a sequence of steps (use a stepper)

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: line: a 3px underline on the selected tab over the bottom border; contained: a selected-surface pill

anatomy.name: panel
anatomy.description: an optional TabPanel, labelled by its tab, shown only when selected

showBorder.description: Shows the border: the bottom line for `line`, the container border for `contained`.

accessibility.labelRequired: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the tab list
accessibility.keyboard: Left/Right (wrapping), Home, End; skips disabled tabs; automatic activation

behaviorRules: Render a role=tablist of role=tab buttons from the tabs array.
Select the first enabled tab by default (or defaultValue); support controlled value + onValueChange.
Wire each TabPanel to its tab via aria-controls / aria-labelledby, and show only the selected panel.
Use roving tabindex - only the selected tab is tabbable.
Move selection with the arrow keys (wrapping) plus Home/End, skipping disabled tabs (automatic activation).
Draw the line underline indicator (3px) over the tab list border, or fill the contained selected pill.
For the contained type, wrap the tab list in a raised, radius-xl, padded segmented container.
Do not select disabled tabs; use the native disabled attribute.
Show the border by default for both types (the bottom line for line, the container border for contained); allow showBorder to turn it off.
compositionRules: Provide one TabPanel per tab value as children, or render panels yourself off value.
Give the tab list an accessible name.
contentRules: Keep the tab count small; use another pattern for many sections.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: Use React.forwardRef on Tabs and TabPanel.
Use a context so TabPanel reads the active value and shared ids.
Use CSS Modules and the shared Focus Ring.
do: Use Tabs to switch between peer views.
Give the tab list an aria-label.
Use line by default; contained for denser surfaces.
dont: Do not use Tabs for page navigation or step sequences.
Do not overload with many tabs.
Do not hardcode colors, spacing, or typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a labelled tablist with a tab per item.
Selects the first enabled tab by default; honors defaultValue.
Selects a tab on click and shows its panel.
Wires each panel to its tab with ARIA.
Moves selection with arrow keys, Home, End, skipping disabled tabs.
Does not select a disabled tab.
Applies the type on the root.
